trackingEnabled.description: Record SaaS app usage (visits and active time per app domain).

trackingScope.description: "catalog" records only known/custom/classified apps; "all-domains" records any registrable domain (domain only).

ignoreDomains.description: Company/internal domains or host patterns that are never recorded.

retentionDays.description: Days of daily totals kept in the browser (default 90).

idleSeconds.description: Seconds without input after which active time stops counting (minimum 15, default 60).

customApps.description: Extra apps: [{ domain, name, category, vendor }]. Overrides the built-in catalog for the same domain.

sanctionedApps.description: Approved app domains or host patterns.

unsanctionedApps.description: Discouraged or forbidden app domains or host patterns.

alternatives.description: Map of unsanctioned domain/pattern to the approved alternative: { "wetransfer.com": { "name": "OneDrive", "url": "https://..." } }.

licensedApps.description: Apps the company pays for: [{ domain, name, seats }].

licenseUnusedDays.description: A licensed app counts as unused when not seen for this many days (default 30).

reportingEnabled.description: Send periodic reports (only when reportEndpoint is set).

reportEndpoint.description: URL that receives POSTed JSON reports.

reportHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers sent with reports, e.g. { "Authorization": "Bearer ..." }.

reportPeriodDays.description: Rolling number of days of totals included in each report (default 30).

includeUnknownDomains.description: In "all-domains" scope, also report domains that are not in the catalog or classified.

includeUserEmail.description: Add user.email to reports (off by default).

userEmail.description: Email address reported when includeUserEmail is on.

notifyOnUnsanctioned.description: "notice" shows a dismissible notice (once per app per day) when an unsanctioned app is opened; "off" disables it.

noticeLearnMoreUrl.description: Link for the "Why?" button in the notice (defaults to brand.supportUrl).

brand.description: Company brand kit applied to every page and notice.

defaults.description: Suggested values the user may change (same keys as above).
